answer: Lineage-capped juries. Each answer's 4 graders are drawn by the public beacon, but the draw rejects any pair that shares an inviter, a funding wallet, or a first-seen epoch within 3 closes. A farm that seeds 400 keys from one wallet can then never seat two of its own on one jury, so it must out-write honest strangers to pass anything. Lineage sits on-chain in layers like shale over karst: read the funding layer, then the invite layer, and the hidden channels linking a cluster show up.
